verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying:

verses.he: מַלֵּל עִם כָּל כְּנִשְׁתָּא דִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתֵימַר לְהוֹן קַדִּישִׁין תְּהוֹן אֲרֵי קַדִּישׁ אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן:
verses.en: Speak to the entire congregation [of] Bnei Yisroel and say to them: You shall be holy, for I, Adonoy, your God, am holy.

verses.he: גְּבַר מִן אִמֵּיהּ וּמִן אֲבוּהִי תְּהוֹן דָּחֲלִין וְיָת יוֹמֵי שַׁבַּיָּא דִילִי תִּטְרוּן אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן:
verses.en: A man—you shall fear his mother and father and keep [the days of] My Sabbaths, I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: לָא תִתְפְּנוּן בָּתַר טַעֲוָן וְדַחֲלָן דְּמַתְּכָא לָא תַעְבְּדוּן לְכוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן:
verses.en: Do not turn to the [false] idols and do not make molten gods for yourselves, I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: וַאֲרֵי תִכְּסוּן נִכְסַת קוּדְשַׁיָּא קֳדָם יְיָ לְרַעֲוָא לְכוֹן תִּכְּסֻנֵּיהּ:
verses.en: When you slaughter a peace[sacred]-offering to [before] Adonoy, you shall slaughter it to be acceptable for you.

verses.he: בְּיוֹמָא דְיִתְנְכֵס יִתְאֲכֵל וּבְיוֹמָא דְבַתְרוֹהִי וּדְאִשְׁתָּאַר עַד יוֹמָא תְלִיתָאָה בְּנוּרָא יִתּוֹקָד:
verses.en: On the day that it is slaughtered it may be eaten and on the next day. Whatever is left over by the third day shall be burned in fire.

verses.he: וְאִם אִתְאֲכָלָא יִתְאֲכֵל בְּיוֹמָא תְלִיתָאָה מְרָחָק הוּא לָא יְהֵי לְרַעֲוָא:
verses.en: And if it should be eaten at all on the third day it is an abomination [a rejection], it will not be favorably accepted.

verses.he: וּדְיֵיכְלִנֵּיהּ חוֹבֵיהּ יְקַבֵּל אֲרֵי יָת קוּדְשָׁא דַיְיָ אַחֵל וְיִשְׁתֵּיצֵי אֲנָשָׁא הַהוּא מְעַמֵּיהּ:
verses.en: Whoever eats from it shall bear his iniquity, for the sacred [things] of Adonoy he has defiled. That [persons] soul shall be cut off from its people.

verses.he: וּבְמֶחְצָדְכוֹן יָת חֲצָדָא דְאַרְעֲכוֹן לָא תְשֵׁיצֵי פָּאתָא דְחַקְלָךְ לְמֶחְצָד וּלְקָטָא דַחֲצָדָךְ לָא תְלַקֵּט:
verses.en: When you will reap the harvest of your land, you shall not completely reap a corner of your field, and the gleanings of your harvest you shall not gather.

verses.he: וְכַרְמָךְ לָא תְעָלֵל וְנִתְרָא דְכַרְמָךְ לָא תְלַקֵּט לְעַנְיֵי וּלְגִיּוֹרֵי תִּשְׁבּוֹק יָתְהוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן:
verses.en: You shall not glean your vineyard, and the fallen grapes of your vineyard, you shall not gather. For the poor and the proselyte you shall leave them, I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: לָא תִּגְנְבוּן וְלָא תְכַדְּבוּן וְלָא תְשַׁקְּרוּן אֱנַשׁ בְּחַבְרֵיהּ:
verses.en: You shall not steal. You shall not deny [a rightful claim] and each one of you shall not lie to each other.

verses.he: וְלָא תִשָּׁבְעוּן בִּשְׁמִי לְשִׁקְרָא וְתַחֵל יָת שְׁמָא דֶאֱלָהָךְ אֲנָא יְיָ:
verses.en: You shall not swear falsely by My Name profaning the Name of your God, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: לָא תַעֲשׁוֹק יָת חַבְרָךְ וְלָא תְאַנֵּס לָא תְבִית אַגְרָא דַאֲגִירָא לְוָתָךְ עַד צַפְרָא:
verses.en: You shall not withhold the wages of your fellow [Jew] and you shall not rob [oppress]. It shall not remain overnight, [You shall not withhold] the wages of a day-laborer, keeping it in your possession until morning.

verses.he: לָא תְלוּט דְּלָא שָׁמַע וְקֳדָם דְּלָא חָזֵי לָא תְשִׂים תַּקְלָא וְתִדְחַל מֵאֱלָהָךְ אֲנָא יְיָ:
verses.en: You shall not curse a deaf person [who can not hear] and before a blind person [who can not see] you shall not place a stumbling-block; you shall fear your God, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: לָא תַעְבְּדוּן שְׁקַר בְּדִינָא לָא תִסַּב אַפֵּי מַסְכֵּנָא וְלָא תֶהְדַּר אַפֵּי רַבָּא בְּקוּשְׁטָא תְּדִינֵיהּ לְחַבְרָךְ:
verses.en: You shall not commit injustice [lie] in judgement, you shall not favor a poor man and you shall not show honor to a powerful man. With righteousness [truth] shall you judge your fellow [Jew].

verses.he: לָא תֵיכוּל קוּרְצִין בְּעַמָּךְ לָא תְקוּם עַל דְּמָא דְחַבְרָךְ אֲנָא יְיָ:
verses.en: Do not be a tale-bearer [’eat and wink’] among your people. You shall not stand idly by [when] the blood (life) of your fellow [is in danger]. I am Adonoy.

verses.he: לָא תִשְׂנֵי יָת אֲחוּךְ בְּלִבָּךְ אוֹכָחָא תוֹכַח יָת חַבְרָךְ וְלָא תְקַבֵּל עַל דִּי לֵיהּ חוֹבָא:
verses.en: You shall not hate your brother in your heart; You shall certainly rebuke your friend; [but] you shall not bear a sin on his account.

verses.he: לָא תִקּוֹם וְלָא תִטַּר דְּבָבוּ לִבְנֵי עַמָּךְ וּתְרַחֵם לְחַבְרָךְ כְּוָתָךְ אֲנָא יְיָ:
verses.en: You shall not take revenge or bear a grudge against the children of your people. You shall love your fellow [Jew] as yourself, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: יָת קְיָמַי תִּטְּרוּן בְּעִירָךְ לָא תַרְכֵּב עֵרוּבִין חַקְלָךְ לָא תִזְרַע עֵרוּבִין וּלְבוּשׁ עֵרוּבִין שַׁעַטְנֵזָא לָא יִסַּק עֲלָךְ:
verses.en: Keep My statutes; Do not cross-breed your animals with different species. Do not sow your field with a mixture of different seeds. A garment that contains shatnez [a forbidden mixture of linen and wool] you shall not wear.

verses.he: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יִשְׁכּוּב עִם אִתְּתָא שִׁכְבַת זַרְעָא וְהִיא אַמְתָא אֲחִידָא לִגְבַר וְאִתְפְּרָקָא לָא אִתְפְּרִיקַת בְּכַסְפָּא אוֹ חֵרוּתָא לָא אִתְיְהִיבַת לַהּ בִּשְׁטָר בִּקֻּרְתָּא תְהֵי לָא יוּמְתוּן אֲרֵי לָא אִתְחָרָרַת:
verses.en: If a man lies with a woman in a conjugal manner, and she is a maid-servant designated for a [specific] man and she has certainly not been redeemed [with money], or her freedom was not given to her [through a document]; there shall be an investigation they shall not be put to death, for her freedom was not given to her.

verses.he: וְיַיְתִי יָת אַשְׁמֵיהּ קֳדָם יְיָ לִתְרַע מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא דְּכַר לַאֲשָׁמָא:
verses.en: He shall bring his guilt-offering to [before] Adonoy, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, a guilt-offering-ram.

verses.he: וִיכַפֵּר עֲלוֹהִי כַהֲנָא בְּדִכְרָא דַאֲשָׁמָא קֳדָם יְיָ עַל חוֹבְתֵיהּ דִּי חָב וְיִשְׁתְּבֵק לֵיהּ מֵחוֹבְתֵיהּ דִּי חָב:
verses.en: The kohein shall atone for him with the guilt-offering-ram before Adonoy for the sin which he committed and he will be forgiven for the sin which he committed.

verses.he: וַאֲרֵי תֵעֲלוּן לְאַרְעָא וְתִצְּבוּן כָּל אִלַּן דְּמֵיכַל וּתְרַחֲקוּן רָחָקָא יָת אִבֵּיהּ תְּלַת שְׁנִין יְהֵי לְכוֹן מְרָחָק לַאֲבָדָא לָא יִתְאֲכֵל:
verses.en: When you will enter the land and you will plant any food-bearing tree, you shall regard its fruit as closed off [separated]. [For] three years it shall be closed off [separated] to you [to be destroyed], it shall not be eaten.

verses.he: וּבְשַׁתָּא רְבִיעֵתָא יְהֵי כָּל אִבֵּיהּ קֹדֶשׁ תֻּשְׁבְּחָן קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: On the fourth year, all of its fruit shall be holy [upon which to say] praise[s to] [before] Adonoy.

verses.he: וּבְשַׁתָּא חֲמִשֵּׁתָא תֵּיכְלוּן יָת אִבֵּיהּ לְאוֹסָפָא לְכוֹן עֲלַלְתֵּיהּ אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן:
verses.en: On the fifth year, you may eat its fruit, so that it will increase its produce for you, I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: לָא תֵיכְלוּן עַל דְּמָא לָא תְנַחֲשׁוּן וְלָא תְעוֹנוּן:
verses.en: You shall not eat [sacred offerings] [before] the blood [is sprinkled on the altar]. You shall not act on the basis of omens nor act on the basis of auspicious times.

verses.he: לָא תַקְּפוּן פָּאתָא דְרֵישְׁכוֹן וְלָא תְחַבֵּל יָת פָּאתָא דְדִקְנָךְ:
verses.en: Do not round the corners of [the hair on] your heads and you shall not destroy [by shaving] the edges of your beard.

verses.he: וְחִבּוּל עַל מִית לָא תִתְּנוּן בְּבִסְרְיכוֹן וְרוּשְׁמִין חֲרִיתִין לָא תִתְּנוּן בְּכוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ:
verses.en: Gashes for the dead do not make in your skin. Do not put tattoo marks on yourselves, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: לָא תַחֵל יָת בְּרַתָּךְ לְאַטְעֲיוּתַהּ וְלָא תִטְעֵי אַרְעָא וְתִתְמְלֵי אַרְעָא עֵצַת חִטְאִין:
verses.en: You shall not defile your daughter by causing her to engage in harlotry [err] lest the land be turned astray, and the land be filled with lewdness [a sinful plan].

verses.he: יָת יוֹמֵי שַׁבַּיָּא דִילִי תִּטְרוּן וּלְבֵית מַקְדְּשִׁי תְּהוֹן דַּחֲלִין אֲנָא יְיָ:
verses.en: You shall keep [the days of] My Shabbosos and you shall fear [the House of] My Sanctuary, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: לָא תִתְפְּנוּן בָּתַר בִּדִּין וּדְכוּרוּ לָא תִתְבְּעוּן לְאִסְתָּאָבָא בְּהוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן:
verses.en: You shall not turn to mediums nor seek out oracles; do not seek [them] out, so as to defile yourselves through them. I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: מִן קֳדָם דְּסַבַּר בְּאוֹרַיְתָא תְּקוּם וּתְהַדַּר אַפֵּי סָבָא וְתִדְחַל מֵאֱלָהָךְ אֲנָא יְיָ:
verses.en: In the presence of the elderly [one who understands the Torah] you shall rise and you shall respect an elder; you shall have fear of your God, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: וַאֲרֵי יִתְגַּיַּר עִמָּךְ גִּיּוֹרָא בְּאַרְעֲכוֹן לָא תוֹנוּן יָתֵיהּ:
verses.en: If a proselyte comes to live [converts] with you, in your land, do not cause him anguish.

verses.he: כְּיַצִּיבָא מִנְּכוֹן יְהֵי לְכוֹן גִּיּוֹרָא דְּיִתְגַּיַּר בֵּינֵיכוֹן וּתְרַחֵם לֵיהּ כְּוָתָךְ אֲרֵי דַיָּרִין הֲוֵיתוּן בְּאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן:
verses.en: As one of your native born [settled ones] he shall be considered by you, the proselyte who lives with [converts among] you, and you shall love him as yourself, for you were strangers [foreign resident] in the land of Egypt, I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: לָא תַעְבְּדוּן שְׁקַר בְּדִין בִּמְשַׁחְתָּא בְּמַתְקְלָא וּבִמְכִלְתָּא:
verses.en: You shall not commit injustice [lie] in judgement; in [land] measure, in weight or in volume measure.

verses.he: מֹאזְנָוָן דִּקְשׁוֹט מַתְקְלָן דִּקְשׁוֹט מְכִילָן דִּקְשׁוֹט וְהִינִין דִּקְשׁוֹט יְהוֹן לְכוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן דִּי אַפֵּקִית יָתְכוֹן מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם:
verses.en: Just scales and just weights a just dry measure (ephah) [just volume measures] and a just liquid measure (hin) [just hinin] you shall have for yourselves, I am Adonoy, your God who has taken you out of the land of Egypt.

verses.he: וְתִטְּרוּן יָת כָּל קְיָמַי וְיָת כָּל דִּינַי וְתַעְבְּדוּן יָתְהוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ:
verses.en: You must keep all my statutes and all of my laws, and do [observe] them. I am Adonoy.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying:

verses.he: וְעִם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תֵּימַר גְּבַר גְּבַר מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִין גִּיּוֹרָא דְּיִתְגַּיְרוּן בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל דִּי יִתֵּן מִזַּרְעֵיהּ לְמוֹלֶךְ אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקְטֵל עַמָּא בֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל יִרְגְּמֻנֵּיהּ בְּאַבְנָא:
verses.en: And to Bnei Yisrael you shall say: that each and every man of Bnei Yisroel and from the proselytes that reside [convert] in Israel, who will give any of his children to Molech, [that] he shall surely be put to death; the people of the land [House of Israel] shall stone him to death.

verses.he: וַאֲנָא אֶתֵּן יָת רוּגְזִי בְּגַבְרָא הַהוּא וֶאֱשֵׁיצֵי יָתֵיהּ מִגּוֹ עַמֵּיהּ אֲרֵי מִזַּרְעֵיהּ יְהַב לְמוֹלֶךְ בְּדִיל לְסָאֲבָא יָת מַקְדְּשִׁי וּלְאַחַלָּא יָת שְׁמָא דְקוּדְשִׁי:
verses.en: I shall direct My wrath on that man and I shall cut him off from among his people, for he gave of his children to Molech, in order to defile My Sanctuary and profane My Holy Name.

verses.he: וְאִם מִכְבַּשׁ יִכְבְּשׁוּן עַמָּא בֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל יָת עֵינֵיהוֹן מִן גַּבְרָא הַהוּא בִּדְיָהֵב מִזַּרְעֵיהּ לְמוֹלֶךְ בְּדִיל דְּלָא לְקַטָּלָא יָתֵיהּ:
verses.en: If the people of the land [House of Israel] will hide their eyes from that person, when he gives of his children to Molech, and they do not put him to death.

verses.he: וֶאֱשַׁוֵּי אֲנָא יָת רוּגְזִי בְּגַבְרָא הַהוּא וּבִסְעָדוֹהִי וֶאֱשֵׁיצֵי יָתֵיהּ וְיָת כָּל דְּטָעָן בַּתְרוֹהִי לְמִטְעֵי בָּתַר מוֹלֶךְ מִגּוֹ עַמְּהוֹן:
verses.en: I shall set My wrath against that man and his family [supporters]; I shall cut him off, along with all those who go astray after him to go astray after Molech, [they will be cut off] from among their people.

verses.he: וֶאֱנַשׁ דִּי יִתְפְּנֵי בָּתַר בִּדִּין וּדְכוּרוּ לְמִטְעֵי בַתְרֵיהוֹן וְאֶתֵּן יָת רוּגְזִי בַּאֲנָשָׁא הַהִיא וֶאֱשֵׁיצֵי יָתֵיהּ מִגּוֹ עַמֵּיהּ:
verses.en: The person who turns to mediums and oracles to stray after them; I shall direct My wrath against that person and cut him off from among his people.

verses.he: וְתִתְקַדְּשׁוּן וּתְהוֹן קַדִּישִׁין אֲרֵי אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן:
verses.en: You shall sanctify yourselves and be holy for I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: וְתִטְּרוּן יָת קְיָמַי וְתַעְבְּדוּן יָתְהוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ מְקַדִּשְׁכוֹן:
verses.en: You must keep My statutes and do [observe] them. I am Adonoy who sanctifies you.

verses.he: אֲרֵי גְבַר גְּבַר דִּי יְלוּט יָת אֲבוּהִי וְיָת אִמֵּיהּ אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקְטֵל אֲבוּהִי וְאִמֵּיהּ לַט קְטָלָא חַיָּב:
verses.en: Any man that curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. [Since] he has cursed his father or mother, his blood is on him [he is liable to the death penalty].

verses.he: וּגְבַר דִּי יְגוּף יָת אִתַּת גְּבַר דִּי יְגוּף יָת אִתַּת חַבְרֵיהּ אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקְטֵל גַּיָּפָא וְגַיַּפְתָּא:
verses.en: A man who commits adultery with another mans wife who commits adultery with the wife of his fellow man—they shall surely be put to death—the adulterer and the adulteress.

verses.he: וּגְבַר דִּי יִשְׁכּוּב עִם אִתַּת אֲבוּהִי עֶרְיְתָא דַאֲבוּהִי גַּלִּי אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקַטְּלוּן תַּרְוֵיהוֹן קְטָלָא חַיָּבִין:
verses.en: A man who will lie [conjugally] with his fathers wife has uncovered his fathers nakedness; they both shall surely be put to death, their blood is on them [they are liable to the death penalty].

verses.he: וּגְבַר דִּי יִשְׁכּוּב יָת כַּלְּתֵיהּ אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקַטְּלוּן תַּרְוֵיהוֹן תִּבְלָא עֲבָדוּ קְטָלָא חַיָּבִין:
verses.en: A man who will lie [conjugally] with his daughter-in-law; they both shall surely be put to death they have committed an act of perversion, their blood is on them [they are liable to the death penalty].

verses.he: וּגְבַר דִּי יִשְׁכּוּב יָת דְּכוּרָא מִשְׁכְּבֵי אִתְּתָא תּוֹעֶבְתָּא עֲבָדוּ תַּרְוֵיהוֹן אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקַטְּלוּן קְטָלָא חַיָּבִין:
verses.en: A man who will lie [conjugally] with [another] man, in the same manner as with a woman; they both have committed an abominable act, they shall surely be put to death, their blood is on them [they are liable to the death penalty].

verses.he: וּגְבַר דִּי יִסַּב יָת אִתְּתָא וְיָת אִמַּהּ עֵצַת חִטְאִין הִיא בְּנוּרָא יוֹקְדוּן יָתֵיהּ וְיָתְהֶן וְלָא תְהֵי עֵצַת חִטְאִין בֵּינֵיכוֹן:
verses.en: A man who marries a woman and her mother; it is lewdness [a sinful plan]. They shall be burned in fire, he and [one of] them, and there will no longer be such lewdness [a sinful plan] among you.

verses.he: וּגְבַר דִּי יִתֵּן שְׁכָבְתֵּיהּ בִּבְעִירָא אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקְטֵל וְיָת בְּעִירָא תִּקְטְלוּן:
verses.en: A man who lies [conjugally] with an animal shall surely be put to death, and you shall also kill the animal.

verses.he: וְאִתְּתָא דִּי תִקְרַב לְכָל בְּעִירָא לְמִשְׁלַט בַּהּ וְתִקְטוֹל יָת אִתְּתָא וְיָת בְּעִירָא אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקַטְּלוּן קְטָלָא חַיָּבִין:
verses.en: A woman who presents herself to an animal causing it to copulate with her [control her]; you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be killed, their blood is on them [they are liable to the death penalty].

verses.he: וּגְבַר דִּי יִסַּב יָת אֲחָתֵיהּ בַּת אֲבוּהִי אוֹ בַת אִמֵּיהּ וְיֶחֱזֵי יָת עֶרְיְתַהּ וְהִיא תֶחֱזֵי יָת עֶרְיְתֵיהּ קְלָנָא הוּא וְיִשְׁתֵּיצוּן לְעֵינֵי בְּנֵי עַמְּהוֹן עֶרְיַת אֲחָתֵיהּ גַּלִּי חוֹבֵיהּ יְקַבֵּל:
verses.en: A man who marries his sister, either his fathers daughter or his mothers daughter, and he sees her nakedness and she sees his nakedness; it is a shameful perversion. They shall be cut off before their people he has uncovered the nakedness of his sister, he shall bear [the burden of] his iniquity.

verses.he: וּגְבַר דִּי יִשְׁכּוּב יָת אִתְּתָא סוֹאֲבָתָא וִיגַלִּי יָת עֶרְיְתַהּ יָת קְלָנַהּ גַּלִּי וְהִיא תְגַלֵּי יָת סוֹאֲבַת דְּמָהָא וְיִשְׁתֵּיצוּן תַּרְוֵיהוֹן מִגּוֹ עַמְּהוֹן:
verses.en: A man who will lie [conjugally] with a menstruating [an impure] woman and uncover her nakedness and uncover her source [womb] [shameful perversion] and she has uncovered the source [impurity] of her blood; they shall both be cut off from among their people.

verses.he: וְעֶרְיַת אֲחַת אִמָּךְ וַאֲחַת אָבוּךְ לָא תְגַלֵּי אֲרֵי יָת קָרִיבֵיהּ גַּלִּי חוֹבְהֶן יְקַבְּלוּן:
verses.en: The nakedness of your mothers sister and of your fathers sister, you shall not uncover, for the nakedness of his close kin he will have bared they shall bear [the burden of] their iniquity.

verses.he: וּגְבַר דִּי יִשְׁכּוּב יָת אִתַּת אַח אֲבוּהִי עֶרְיַת אַח אֲבוּהִי גַּלִּי חוֹבְהֶן יְקַבְּלוּן בְּלָא וְלָד יְמוּתוּן:
verses.en: A man who will lie [conjugally] with his aunt [father’s brother’s wife] has uncovered the nakedness of his uncle [father’s brother] they will bear [the burden of] their sin and they will die without children.

verses.he: וּגְבַר דִּי יִסַּב יָת אִתַּת אֲחוּהִי מְרָחָקָא הִיא עֶרְיְתָא דַאֲחוּהִי גַּלִּי בְּלָא וְלָד יְהוֹן:
verses.en: A man who will marry his brothers wife who must be [conjugally] avoided [by him]; he has uncovered his brothers nakedness, they shall die without children.

verses.he: וְתִטְּרוּן יָת כָּל קְיָמַי וְיָת כָּל דִּינַי וְתַעְבְּדוּן יָתְהוֹן וְלָא תְרוֹקֵן יָתְכוֹן אַרְעָא דִּי אֲנָא מַעֵיל יָתְכוֹן תַּמָּן לְמִתַּב בַּהּ:
verses.en: You shall keep all of My statutes and all of My laws and do (observe) them [so that] you will not be expelled by the land to which I am bringing you there to reside therein.

verses.he: וְלָא תְהָכוּן בְּנִימוֹסֵי עַמְמַיָּא דִּי אֲנָא מַגְלֵי מִן קֳדָמֵיכוֹן אֲרֵי יָת כָּל אִלֵּין עֲבָדוּ וְרָחִיק מֵימְרִי יָתְהוֹן:
verses.en: You shall not follow the customs of the nation which I am expelling before you. For they have done all these above mentioned sins and I became disgusted with [my Word distanced] them.

verses.he: וַאֲמָרִית לְכוֹן אַתּוּן תִּירְתוּן יָת אַרְעֲהוֹן וַאֲנָא אֶתְּנִנַּהּ לְכוֹן לְמֵירַת יָתַהּ אַרְעָא עָבְדָא חֲלָב וּדְבָשׁ אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן דִּי אַפְרֵשִׁית יָתְכוֹן מִן עַמְמַיָּא:
verses.en: And I have said to you [that] you shall inherit their land, and I shall give it to you that you may inherit it, a land flowing with [producing] milk and honey, I am Adonoy, your God who separated you from the [other] peoples.

verses.he: וְתַפְרְשׁוּן בֵּין בְּעִירָא דַכְיָא לִמְסָאָבָא וּבֵין עוֹפָא מְסָאָבָא לִדְכֵי וְלָא תְשַׁקְּצוּן יָת נַפְשָׁתֵיכוֹן בִּבְעִירָא וּבְעוֹפָא וּבְכֹל דִּי תַרְחֵשׁ אַרְעָא דִּי אַפְרֵשִׁית לְכוֹן לְסָאָבָא:
verses.en: You shall distinguish between a [ritually] clean animal and a unclean one, between the unclean fowl and the clean one. Do not make yourselves disgusting through the animals, fowl or through any creature that creeps on the ground which I have distinguished for you as being unclean.

verses.he: וּתְהוֹן קֳדָמַי קַדִּישִׁין אֲרֵי קַדִּישׁ אֲנָא יְיָ וְאַפְרֵשִׁית יָתְכוֹן מִן עַמְמַיָּא לְמֶהֱוֵי פָלְחִין קֳדָמָי:
verses.en: You shall be holy to [before] Me, for I, Adonoy, am holy and I have distinguished you from the [other] peoples to be Mine [and to serve Me] [be worshippers before Me].

verses.he: וּגְבַר אוֹ אִתְּתָא אֲרֵי יְהֵי בְהוֹן בִּדִּין אוֹ דְּכוּר אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקַטְּלוּן בְּאַבְנָא יִרְגְּמוּן יָתְהוֹן קְטָלָא חַיָּבִין:
verses.en: If among the men or women there will be a medium or an oracle they shall surely be put to death. You shall stone them to death, their blood is on them [they are liable to the death penalty].
